name: shravan-dev-workflow
description: Shravan's development workflow plugin with bounded design orchestration, research, authoritative Requirements and Specification design, structural program design, independent spec/program review, user-requirements pathfinding, handoffs, PR lifecycle, debugging, operations, skill authoring, agent management, and structured TUI presentation.

interface.shortDescription: Spec/program design, review, planning, implementation, operations, agents, and TUI workflows
interface.longDescription: Use Shravan Dev Workflow to coordinate one bounded design cycle with orchestrator-design, keep Requirements and Specification separate with spec-design, extract unwritten owner meaning with discuss-pathfinding, turn settled observable obligations into structural How with program-design, and independently review Requirements, Specification, Program Design, or their pair. The plugin also gathers source-grounded evidence, packages handoffs, finishes PRs, investigates bugs, routes operations work, authors skills, maintains docs, and structures TUI explanations.
defaultPrompt: Use spec-design to preserve separate Requirements and Specification identities: authorized Why and observable What.
Use program-design to define structural How against this specification.
Use discuss-clarify-mental-models to rebuild the shared map before artifact work.
Use discuss-pathfinding to extract unwritten requirements or decisions before artifact work.
Use research-swarm to gather source-grounded evidence into a tmp ledger.
Use manage-agents to spawn, resume, monitor, or reduce subordinate agent work.
Use orchestrator-design to run this through one bounded Requirements, Specification, Program Design, and pair-review cycle before planning.
Use docs-maintain to reconcile these docs with current code and plans.
Use spec-program-review to independently review this specification and program design.
Use spec-handoff to package this design for another agent.
Use plan-improve-repo to audit this repo and write executable improvement plans.
Use ops-security-review to choose the right Codex Security scan.
Use ops-observability-stack to prove local logs, metrics, and traces through the shared stack.
Use implementation-pr-wrapup to finish this PR.
Investigate this bug before fixing it.
Use skills-creation to create, update, or evaluate one named skill.
Audit these skills against session evidence.
